# Cache changelog (active implementation)

## 2026-11-25 — quality and evidence pass

- Moved the semantic threshold default from `0.95` to the measured `0.85`.
- Added a committed threshold sweep with hard negatives.
- Added exact-cache Redis/in-memory TTL behavior and tests.
- Added a two-worker Redis consistency check.
- Replaced unsupported legacy coverage/performance claims with links to
  `data/evidence/`.

Older autogenerated "v2.0 scale" entries were not backed by verifiable artifacts
and have been removed. Historical source material remains under `docs/archive/`.
